remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST BY TUESDAY, APRIL 1ST 5PM. Welcome to this fabulous light-filled 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath home located on a serene cul-de-sac in West Norwalk just minutes away from New Canaan. The property boasts beautiful curb appeal with a circular driveway leading to a welcoming foyer. This open concept, split-level home offers expansive living spaces perfect for modern living.  Step into the lower-level family room, which features a beautiful fireplace for cozy nights with large windows with views of the water feature and access to the garage. On the main level, you'll find a spacious living room with a stunning bay window that bathes the space in natural light. It seamlessly flows into the modern kitchen, equipped with all the latest appliances and a spacious island, as well as the dining room, and sliders that open to a backyard retreat complete with a waterfall, stone patio, deck, and above-ground pool. This home is ideal for entertaining, cooking, or simply relaxing.  Upstairs, there are four generously sized bedrooms and a full bath. The primary suite features an updated farmhouse-style bathroom, a walk-in closet, and views of the meticulously manicured lawn. The home also includes a lower-level laundry room with an extra playroom room, a two-car garage, high ceilings, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout.  Experience the seamless blend of elegance and modernity at 7 Red Oak Lane, a remarkable opportunity in one of Norwalk's most desirable areas.
